title: Polynomial-Time Addition-Tag Recognition
statement: The function on bit strings that returns the one-bit word $[1]$ when the second and fourth bits are $1$ and the third bit is $0$, and returns $[0]$ otherwise, is polynomial-time computable. In particular, a deterministic Turing machine with finitely many states computes it on every input of length $n$ within $C(n+1)^c$ steps for some $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$.
